state.description: Relevant evidence to send to TypeSafe; do not include credentials or unrelated context.

questions.description: Named Jev questions. Each value has type (noul, choice, score), instructions (string/object/array), and criteria: choice = option-to-description map (1–255, null descriptions allowed); score = 2–10 ordered descriptions; noul = optional true/false descriptions. One explicit judgment per question. The handler validates every question.

supported.instructions: Does the supplied evidence support the claim?

route.instructions: Which next step fits the evidence?

coverage.instructions: How thoroughly do the supplied tests cover the requirement?
